device.description: dual 12-bit 40 MSPS current-output DAC with an interleaved parallel port, plus four 12-bit voltage-output DACs with a serial interface
device.note: dac2932.pdf (SBAS279D) p.4 electrical characteristics (+VD, +VDV 2.7-3.3 V), p.6 I-DAC timing (Figure 1), p.7 V-DAC serial write timing (Figure 2) and serial data input format, p.8-9 pin assignments and terminal functions, p.15 power-down modes (Table 1), p.16 chip-select operation (Figure 28), p.21-22 V-DAC serial interface, input shift register, SYNC interrupt, power-on reset

registers.name: IDAC1
registers.note: I-DAC data latch, written only through the parallel port (not modeled)

registers.name: IDAC2
registers.note: I-DAC data latch, written only through the parallel port (not modeled)

registers.name: VDAC1
registers.note: V-DAC1 register: power-on filled with zeros (p.22); no double buffering, the output follows the register

registers.name: VDAC2
registers.note: V-DAC2 register: power-on filled with zeros (p.22); no double buffering, the output follows the register

registers.name: VDAC3
registers.note: V-DAC3 register: power-on filled with zeros (p.22); no double buffering, the output follows the register

registers.name: VDAC4
registers.note: V-DAC4 register: power-on filled with zeros (p.22); no double buffering, the output follows the register

commands.name: V-DAC write
commands.note: p.7: DB15-DB12 = A0-A3 select V-DAC1-4 (one-hot; several set = same data to each), DB11-DB0 data, MSB first; executed on the 16th SCLK falling edge (SYNC high earlier aborts)

protocol.note: the modeled bus is the V-DAC serial port (SYNC, SCLK, DIN); channels 0-1 are the I-DACs, 2-5 the V-DACs

pages: p.4 (supplies, logic levels), p.6 (I-DAC timing, Figure 1), p.7 (V-DAC timing, Figure 2, serial data format), p.8-9 (terminal functions), p.15 (Table 1 power-down modes), p.16 (chip select, Figure 28), p.21-22 (serial interface, input shift register, SYNC interrupt, power-on reset)
notModeled: I-DAC parallel port (D11-D0, CLK, CS): interleaved double-data-rate input (channel 1 latched on CLK rising, channel 2 on CLK falling, the pair output on the next rising edge; CS gated through the clock interface) cannot be expressed next to the V-DAC serial port, so the I-DAC registers are never written
PD (I-DAC full power-down), STBY (I-DAC standby) and PDV (V-DAC power-down) pins: no effect in the model (the V-DAC serial port is not documented as disabled by PDV)
analog current and voltage outputs, references, full-scale adjust and GSET
a write with all four address bits 0 is accepted and changes nothing
SPI mode: DIN clocked on SCLK falling edges; mode 2 per Figure 2 (SYNC falls while SCLK is high)
